SEARCH

Class SlotMachineException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
SlotMachineException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SlotMachineException extends Exception
Exception thrown when an operation of the slot machine can't be done. Its constants hold every error message of the simulator; the ones with %s or %d are completed with String.format before throwing.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Oscar Poveda, Elian Ibarra
